stage: P2 conditioned BPTT native-rope first round; P3 disabled

development_guard.safety_rule: No previously safe case may newly fail; total safe count cannot decrease. Existing failures may remain while full-horizon cost improves; this is not final acceptance.
development_guard.command_rule: Initial command comparison uses identical initial onboard observation/history. Full-trajectory command differences are reported, not bounded, because different failure/trajectory paths are not identical-input policy changes.

policy_route: Only thrust+body-rate BPTT; no P3 compensation, PPO, imitation or truth observation
gradient_kind: MuJoCo native constraint force forward, central-difference first-order VJP, PyTorch RK4 mechanics and original controller/observer BPTT
rope_scope: 5/10cm, native soft maximum lengths4.90/4.85m, no mass/sag, target5m unchanged; limits are not the old elastic rest-length law
